description:
Use this when the user asks what FIIs and DIIs have been buying or selling in Indian equities day by day across the whole market. Not for a company's ownership percentage; use get_shareholding.

Market-wide DAILY FII/DII net cash-flow (Rs crore), NSE cash (Capital Market) segment.

    NOT the shareholding data: get_shareholding gives per-company QUARTERLY FII/DII holding
    PERCENTAGES; this gives market-wide DAILY net buy/sell/net value in Rs crore -- e.g. "FIIs
    net sold Rs 2,340 Cr, DIIs net bought Rs 1,890 Cr" for a given trading day. `from_date`/
    `to_date` are optional ISO dates (default: trailing ~30 days); `segment` is "cash" only.
    For NSE participant-wise F&O positioning, use `get_fo_participant_activity`. Raw
    figures; `net = buy - sell` is the only computation, with no interpretation added.
    The envelope's `source` reflects actual per-call provenance: recent
    dates are NSE-live (`source="nse"`), older dates come from a one-time historical backfill by
    a secondary public source,
    since NSE publishes no bulk cash-history archive (each row's `source` names its origin), and
    a query
    window spanning both returns `source="mixed"`.
name: get_market_fii_dii_flow
title: FII and DII market flow
